[[File:Atlatl dart 5 detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Atlatl darts''' are [[ammunition]] used exclusively by the [[eclipse atlatl]], which is obtained as a possible reward from the [[Lunar Chest]] in [[Neypotzli]]. Alternatively the darts can be crafted, requiring level 74 [[Fletching]], [[Headless atlatl dart]] and [[Atlatl dart tips]]. Ironmen additionally require 54 [[Slayer]] in order to obtain [[broken antler]]s, which are required to make the dart tips.

The atlatl dart has no bonuses as the eclipse atlatl uses the player's melee strength bonus to deal damage.

Despite being called [[dart]]s, atlatl darts cannot be loaded into the [[toxic blowpipe]], and they deal [[Ranged#Weapons|standard]] ranged damage.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Halo|url=https://twitter.com/JagexHalo/status/1797726734244294720|date=3 June 2024|quote=Ah, well from what I can see, the Eclipse atlatl is using the standard ranged style, much like a regular bow. Karil's is heavy as thats using bolts.|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27963360|archivedate=7 April 2026}}

Despite being equipped in the ammo slot, they cannot be stored in [[Dizana's quiver]]. Attempting to do so displays the following message: "You have nothing in your worn quiver to fill your Dizana's Quiver with."

Atlatl darts are compatible with [[Ava's device]]s, however the Ranged strength bonus on them will not affect their damage, making other capes like a [[Fire cape]] more preferable if not concerned with saving the darts.
